system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I have an upcoming trip from New York to Chicago, and I'd like to make some changes to the booking.

I can help with that. To get started I need a few details:

1) Please provide your user id and the reservation id for the New York → Chicago booking.  
   - If you don’t know the reservation id, I can look up your reservations by user id — please confirm you want me to do that.

2) Tell me exactly what change(s) you want to make (you can pick one or more):
   - Change flights (please provide the new flight numbers and dates you want, or tell me preferred new travel dates/times)  
   - Change cabin class (to basic_economy, economy, or business)  
   - Add checked baggage (how many additional checked bags total)  
   - Modify passenger info (first name, last name, DOB for each passenger; note you cannot change the number of passengers)  

Important rules I must follow (so I can check them before making changes):
- If any segment is basic_economy, that reservation cannot be modified (only cabin changes are allowed in some cases).  
- Changing flights cannot change origin, destination, or trip type.  
- If flights are changed and the price difference is positive, you must pay with a single credit card or single gift card already in your profile; if negative, refund goes to a single card in your profile. Please tell me which payment method in your profile to use if a charge/refund will be needed.  
- You can add but not remove checked bags.  
- You cannot add travel insurance after booking.  
- Before I make any update I will list the exact action I will perform and I will need your explicit confirmation ("yes").

Tell me the user id and reservation id (or say “lookup” to let me find the reservation), and exactly which changes you want. Once I have that I’ll check the reservation and outline the required actions and any costs.

My user id is omar_rossi_1241. I don’t have the reservation id handy, so please look up my reservations.

Here are the changes I’d like to make:
- Change the passenger to myself (Omar Rossi)
- Upgrade to economy class
- Add a total of 3 checked bags

If there’s any additional cost, I’d like to use a gift card from my profile for payment.
